title: Antihyperglycemic effect of an anthocyanin, cyanidin-3-O-glucoside, is achieved by regulating GLUT-1 via the Wnt/beta-catenin-WISP1 signaling pathway.
authors: Ye, Xiang; Chen, Wen; Tu, Pengcheng; Jia, Ruoyi; Liu, Yangyang; Tang, Qiong; Chen, Chuan; Yang, Caihong; Zheng, Xiaodong; Chu, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 研究花青素C3G通过Wnt/β-catenin-WISP1通路调节GLUT-1的降糖作用，仅用分子对接模拟C3G与β-catenin结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyanidin-3-O-glucoside (C3G), an essential representative of anthocyanins, has been proved to possess a myriad of biological activities. However, the effects of C3G on glucose metabolism and its underlying molecular mechanisms remain elusive. The aim of the present study was to investigate the metabolic impact of C3G on db/db mice and to determine whether its consequent anti-diabetic effects were related to glucose transporter-1 (GLUT-1) by in vivo and in vitro studies. As a result, through diabetic db/db mice, C3G treatment was found to significantly reduce the fasting blood glucose level and increase glycogen synthesis, which were associated with upregulation of GLUT-1 expression in the liver of the mice. In addition, in liver cells of the HepG2 and L02 lines, we further discovered that C3G could effectively promote glucose consumption by regulating the Wnt/beta-catenin-WISP1 signaling pathway. Nevertheless, such effects would be restricted when the expression of GLUT-1 was blocked by the inhibitor IWR-1. Meanwhile, molecular docking technology was applied to simulate the possible action sites of C3G at the molecular level, and the results indicated that C3G might bind to beta-catenin. In conclusion, our study provided evidence of the antihyperglycemic effect of C3G in vivo and in vitro via regulating GLUT-1 expression and the related signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 花青素-3-O-葡萄糖苷（C3G）作为花青素的重要代表，已被证明具有多种生物活性。然而，C3G对葡萄糖代谢的影响及其潜在分子机制仍不明确。本研究旨在通过体内和体外实验，探讨C3G对db/db小鼠的代谢影响，并确定其随之产生的抗糖尿病效应是否与葡萄糖转运蛋白-1（GLUT-1）相关。结果表明，在糖尿病db/db小鼠中，C3G处理显著降低了空腹血糖水平并增加了糖原合成，这些变化与小鼠肝脏中GLUT-1表达的上调有关。此外，在HepG2和L02细胞系中，我们进一步发现C3G可通过调节Wnt/β-catenin-WISP1信号通路有效促进葡萄糖消耗。然而，当GLUT-1表达被抑制剂IWR-1阻断时，这些效应受到限制。同时，应用分子对接技术在分子水平上模拟C3G的可能作用位点，结果表明C3G可能结合β-catenin。总之，我们的研究提供了C3G通过调节GLUT-1表达及相关信号通路在体内和体外发挥抗高血糖作用的证据。
